cards.text: Pull up a stool, friend. This is a letter from Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus, to the saints in Ephesus, the faithful in Christ Jesus. He opens with grace and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ, which already beats the takeout menus I read for YEARS in that junk drawer.

cards.question: Paul calls himself an apostle of Christ Jesus. How does he say that came about?

answers.text: By a vote of the church

cards.text: Then Paul skips the small talk and goes straight to "Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ," and friend, he is ROLLING. He says God has blessed us in Christ in the heavenly realms.

cards.question: Paul says God has blessed us in Christ with ___ spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.

cards.text: Paul says God chose us in Him before the foundation of the world. Before the WORLD, friend, and I got picked out of a 25-cent bin at a closing sale and was THRILLED about it.

cards.question: Paul says God chose His people before the foundation of the world. What did He choose them to be?

answers.text: Holy and blameless in His presence
Rulers over every nation on earth
Teachers of the law in every city

cards.text: Then Paul says God predestined us for something. And friend, this one gets me right in the mustache.

cards.question: Paul says God predestined His people for something through Jesus Christ. What was it?
Paul says God predestined His people for this adoption in love.

cards.text: Adopted, according to the good pleasure of His will. Friend, when six little cookie cutters started calling me Papa, I about rusted from happy tears.

cards.question: Paul says all of this is to the praise of something God has freely given us in the Beloved One. What is it?

cards.text: Then Paul gets to what it cost. In Him we have redemption through His blood.

cards.question: Paul says the redemption we have in Christ means freedom from every hardship in life.
Paul talks about the riches of God's grace. He says God ___ that grace on us.

cards.text: Lavished, Paul says, with all wisdom and understanding. That's me with the sprinkles jar when nobody's watching, minus the wisdom.
Paul's still praising God, and friend, the man has NOT taken a breath. Now he brings up the mystery of God's will.

cards.question: Paul says God has kept the mystery of His will hidden from us.
Paul says God purposed this in Christ as a plan for the fullness of time. What does that plan do?

answers.text: Bring all things in heaven and on earth together in Christ
Keep heaven and earth apart from each other until the very end
Raise one nation up above every other nation on the earth

cards.text: ALL things, together in Christ, and back on the Millers' counter I couldn't get six cookie cutters to stand in one straight line. Paul says in Him we were also chosen, by the plan of Him who works out everything by the counsel of His will.

cards.question: Paul says those "who were the first to hope in Christ" were chosen for a reason. What is it?

answers.text: To be for the praise of His glory
To rule over those who came later
To keep the good news to themselves

cards.text: Then Paul turns to the Ephesians themselves. They heard the word of truth, the gospel of their salvation, and they believed it.

cards.question: Paul tells the Ephesians that once they heard and believed, they were ___ with the promised Holy Spirit.

cards.text: SEALED, friend, and you know nothing in this whole bakery makes me happier than a sealed box. Paul says the Holy Spirit is the pledge of something we're waiting on.

cards.question: Paul says the promised Holy Spirit is the pledge of something. What is it?
Paul calls the people God will redeem His own possession.

cards.text: And it all lands on the praise of His glory. That line again, friend, and if Paul can't stop praising, neither can this old stamper.

findings.problem: Ephesians 1:7 says what the redemption is: "the forgiveness of our trespasses." No card ever tells or asks this. Card 13 tests a made-up claim the text never makes (freedom from every hardship). So a key detail of the verse is missed, and the baker never learns what the text actually says redemption is.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.

findings.problem: This question is about something the passage doesn't say, not about the detail the baker needs from Ephesians 1:7. Asking what the redemption in Christ is (the forgiveness of our trespasses) would cover the moment that matters.

rule.text: Ask about the moments that move the passage forward and the details the baker needs to understand it.

findings.problem: Card 1 only says Paul "brings up the mystery of God's will," and the word "mystery" points the baker toward True. Nothing on the earlier cards lets the baker reason out that God "has made known to us" the mystery (1:9). No story card ever states that God made it known, so the baker can only get this right by luck.

rule.text: The check: could a thoughtful baker who has only seen the earlier cards make a reasoned pick? If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question.

findings.problem: The joke invents a new moment in the Millers' kitchen: Papa Dorin couldn't get the six cookie cutters to stand in one straight line. That moment isn't in his backstory. The allowance for made-up moments covers his bakery, not the Millers' kitchen.

rule.text: His own world isn't Bible fact. His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them. His jokes can make up small moments and habits around his bakery.

findings.problem: The card says "in Him we were also chosen, by the plan of Him who works out everything." Ephesians 1:11 says they were chosen as God's own, "having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything." The retelling ties "chosen" to the plan and changes "according to" into "by." That reshapes how the text connects the two ideas.

rule.text: Call things what the text calls them.
